user.title: Connect Zigbee2MQTT
user.description: Read the existing catalog through Home Assistant MQTT. The report extension is optional for setup and required for active pilot testing. No device commands are sent.

data.report_extension: Use Zigbee2MQTT report extension (see installation guide)

mapping.title: Map one circuit
mapping.description: Name the virtual light, then select one LED controller and its power channel. The temperature range is read from the catalog. These timings are shared by every circuit added later. Setup starts in observation mode.

error.invalid_mapping: The configuration or physical mapping is invalid.
error.invalid_name: The virtual entity name must be nonempty and have no surrounding spaces.
error.already_mapped: That name, controller, or relay channel is already used.
error.catalog_unavailable: The Zigbee2MQTT device and group catalog is unavailable.

abort.single_instance: Only one Zigbee LED Orchestrator instance is supported. Add another circuit from Configure on the existing entry.

init.title: Zigbee LED Orchestrator
init.description: Change the control mode or add another switch and controller pair. Adding a circuit reloads the integration and returns it to observation mode.

control.title: Control mode
control.description: Activate on site after verifying mapping, backup/rollback and disabling other writers for these circuits. Fresh reports from the Z2M extension are required. Restart always returns to observation mode.

add_circuit.title: Add circuit
add_circuit.description: Name the virtual light and select one controller with its power channel. Timing settings stay as they are. Saving reloads the integration and returns it to observation mode.

error.control_unavailable: Control is unavailable. Check bridge connectivity, mapping and report-extension diagnostics. Resync after a topology change.
error.invalid_mapping: The configuration or physical mapping is invalid.
error.invalid_name: The virtual entity name must be nonempty and have no surrounding spaces.
error.already_mapped: That name, controller, or relay channel is already used.
error.catalog_unavailable: The Zigbee2MQTT device and group catalog is unavailable.

abort.catalog_unavailable: The Zigbee2MQTT device and group catalog is unavailable.
abort.no_free_circuit: Every discovered controller or relay channel is already mapped.

pause.name: Pause control
pause.description: Disable control and set every light's desired state to off without publishing.

resume.name: Resume control
resume.description: Restore the mode that was active before the pause. Previous commands are not replayed.

resync.name: Resync catalog
resync.description: Discard observations and re-read the Zigbee2MQTT catalog. Control must be enabled again afterwards.
